<quote by="Proposed: Miaren, Seconded: Mitwold">To build a wayhouse in Ossium. To be attached to the Navarr strategos title. This will house refugees from Therunin and assist in funding the Navarr army.</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[Navarr wayhouse]] in Nearweald, Ossium.
* Passed
* More information on this motion can be found in the '''[[The way home]]''' wind of fortune

==Date==
* Spring 387YE

==Cost==
* Standard costs apply
* 16 mithril
* 6 thrones
* 3 months to construct

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Wayhouse_in_Ossium}}
==Outcome==
* Once complete, the [[Strategos|Strategos of Navarr]] will gain custodianship of a sinecure and Navarr will be able to take a personal resource in Ossium without suffering the foreign nation penalty.
